survivedExtractionAuthority.boundary: This proves a bounded survived extraction objective can be materialized. It does not prove that Equipment and extraction occurred in the same raid, and it does not supply operation-specific map or exfil values.

sameRaidCouplingMaterializationPolicy.reason: Both authored operations promise that the qualifying equipment is actually used during the bounded operation that is survived. Separate cross-raid Equipment and ExitStatus progress would violate the player-facing contract.

en.description: Armor is useful only while the man inside it can still finish the route. I am not interested in a warehouse of helmets and plates; prove you can work under protection and come back alive.
en.started: Take a serious protective setup into the field, complete the bounded contact, and extract. I am testing mobility, judgement and survival under armor, not your collection.
en.success: You carried the protection through the operation instead of carrying it to a shelf. Good. Equipment earns its place when it survives contact with the job.

ru.description: Броня полезна только пока человек внутри неё способен закончить маршрут. Склад шлемов и плит меня не интересует; докажи, что умеешь работать под защитой и возвращаться живым.
ru.started: Возьми в поле серьёзный комплект защиты, выполни ограниченный боевой контакт и выйди из рейда. Я проверяю подвижность, решение задачи и выживание под бронёй, а не коллекцию.
ru.success: Защиту ты провёл через операцию, а не просто донёс до полки. Хорошо. Снаряжение заслуживает место тогда, когда переживает вместе с тобой реальную работу.

objectiveIntent: one survived operation while meeting a bounded proven protective-equipment rule
small combat or route objective under protection rather than helmet/body-armor handover

equipmentPlan.equipmentInclusiveSource: explicit curated protective item TPL allowlist
equipmentPlan.remainingBlocker: select and validate the exact pinned SPT 4.1.3 protective TPL allowlist; do not emulate armor-class filtering

materializationBlockedBy: exact pinned SPT 4.1.3 protective-equipment TPL allowlist
operations.rewardDoctrine: XP/RUB/standing by default. No sequential helmet, armor, plate or carrier storefront unlocks; any durable protective-equipment reward requires Economy Admiral review and must not bypass normal capability progression.
proofGates: select and validate an explicit pinned SPT 4.1.3 protective-equipment TPL allowlist; generic armor-class or parent-category inference remains forbidden
prove same-raid coupling before runtime materialization so protective Equipment progress and the Survived extraction cannot be satisfied across different raids
select the bounded operation-specific map/contact values using already-proven condition families
audit vanilla/Scorpion/Artem overlap for protected-combat and equipment-use objectives
Economy Admiral approves final numeric rewards and any protective-equipment reward

en.description: A headset is not a qualification. The qualification is hearing the situation early enough to make a better decision. I need field awareness, not sixteen receipts from an equipment counter.
en.started: Run one reconnaissance contact with a proven hearing-protection setup, keep the engagement bounded, and extract. Do not turn this into a headset shopping tour.
en.success: You heard enough to choose the contact instead of stumbling into it. That is the capability I care about; the model number on the headset is secondary.

ru.description: Гарнитура сама по себе не квалификация. Квалификация — услышать обстановку достаточно рано, чтобы принять лучшее решение. Мне нужна полевая осведомлённость, а не шестнадцать чеков со склада.
ru.started: Проведи один разведывательный контакт с подтверждённым средством защиты слуха, держи бой ограниченным и выйди. Не превращай задачу в экскурсию по витрине наушников.
ru.success: Ты услышал достаточно, чтобы выбрать контакт, а не ввалиться в него случайно. Вот эта способность мне нужна; модель гарнитуры вторична.

objectiveIntent: one bounded reconnaissance/combat contact while using a proven headset equipment allowlist
survive/extract without headset-by-headset progression or gear-restricted kill ladders

equipmentPlan.remainingBlocker: select and validate the exact pinned SPT 4.1.3 headset TPL allowlist; do not infer a generic headset category selector

materializationBlockedBy: exact pinned SPT 4.1.3 headset TPL allowlist
operations.rewardDoctrine: XP/RUB/standing or a tightly bounded support reward only. No headset storefront conveyor and no equipment unlock whose sole purpose is to start another same-shaped quest.
proofGates: select and validate an explicit pinned SPT 4.1.3 headset TPL allowlist; generic category inference remains forbidden
prove same-raid coupling before runtime materialization so headset Equipment progress and the Survived extraction cannot be satisfied across different raids
select the bounded operation-specific map/contact values using already-proven condition families
audit vanilla/Scorpion/Artem overlap for headset-restricted and reconnaissance objectives
Economy Admiral approves final numeric and any support-item rewards
